entry.title: VS Code v1_144: Agents
entry.summary: Assisted permissions are generally available Agents can make many tool calls to accomplish a task. Approving every tool call ensures that each action is explicitly authorized, but it can become cumbersome for frequent or low-risk calls. Giving the agent full autonomy might be risky and result in unintended actions or security issues.
